svg.text: How stereo evidence and temporal history are fused
Operator-level details of the same model. Body attention and local-part MLP fusion are distinct implementations.
N = 2BT. Every branch shares weights across views but keeps the left and right recurrent states separate.
GRU128:256 -> per-eye rotation heads; state + C token -> depth heads
Both attention directions read the original pair inside each block.
Token order: foreground, C, H1, H2, J1, J2. C token is also routed to Z.
(b) Wrist and jaw: two independent local branches
Same GRU weights within a branch; no sharing between wrist and jaw
FC512:256 -> GELU -> FC256:k -> sigmoid joint bounds
U from sigmoid(heat)^4 weighted coordinate expectation; confidence = max sigmoid(heat)
Whole metadata: center(2), spread(2), mean mask(1). Local metadata: uv(2), radius(2), confidence(1).
Predicted foreground routing: stop gradients through mask and ROI
Normalize source RGB; multiply by gated mask BEFORE bilinear ROI sampling
Wrist ROI: C,H,J1,J2 | Jaw ROI: H,J1,J2 | H=(H1+H2)/2
Concatenate foreground RGB + mask; sample [N,4,160,160] for each branch
align_corners=False; zero padding; crop coordinates derived from predicted U
Residual refinement: DWConv3x3(64) -> GN8 -> GELU -> PWConv1x1
Each frame advances all three modules once. Reset on sequence / timestamp / calibration discontinuity; preserve state within a sequence.
Training uses 8-frame windows. Streaming supplies one image pair at a time, with history retained in the three states.
Solid arrows: feature flow. Dashed stereo arrows: other-view input. Auxiliary local heatmaps are skipped by the normal optimized runtime.
